figure_intent.A: Compare the full analytic initial-shear derivative against three actual symmetric nonlinear finite-difference pairs, with Richardson accuracy shown separately.
figure_intent.B: Show the independently measured error caused by each omitted birth-memory derivative contribution.
figure_intent.C: Separate angular refinement and prior/P2/P24 constraints at the fixed native coordinate-grid offset b0=0.6.
figure_intent.D: Repeat the same native comparison and scales at b0=0.9, retaining unavailable cases in a separate status strip.

semantic_checks: Central-difference errors use x>=0.2 and the same h,b,y variables; joint maximum equals b in this particular data set.
The epsilon-squared line is an order guide. Richardson 1.0230571945157863e-10 is separated from the finest central-difference maximum 2.287956546498382e-6.
The omission threshold is max(1e-5,100 times the full y finite-difference error), giving 1.1293536544831895e-5. All three measured omissions exceed it.
The native observable is new-photon DeltaP/U. Old stock cannot dilute this plotted quantity.
Native panels share the same vertical range and the unchanged 1e-6 target. Eight new lower-resolution misses and four measured historical misses remain visible.
The b0=0.9,n64,P24 numerical failure is a plus symbol in the status strip. The two historical n32 support failures are crosses. No missing case is assigned a numerical angular error.
Open n32 markers reuse S7. Lines join only new n>=64 results; the historical versus new internal stopping margin distinction is stated in the caption.
The caption preserves the original tangent process exit1 serialization failure and identifies the separately recorded seven-reused-plus-one-gauge recovery.
The caption distinguishes fixed-coordinate-grid conditioning b0 from physical shear and states the two experiments' separate scopes.
